metaTitle: Custom PL Hot Cold Packs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom PL hot cold packs in bulk for your brand. Perfect for safety kits and employee wellness. Get a quote today.
introHtml: PL hot cold packs combine soft, plush exteriors with flexible gel interiors, making them ideal for corporate wellness programs, first aid kits, and promotional giveaways. Unlike standard vinyl packs, PL options offer a more comfortable feel for end users. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or full-color transfer for a professional look that stands out in break rooms or safety stations.
heroAltText: Custom PL hot cold packs in plush fabric with gel filling, ideal for branding and first aid use
